# Douglas Cirillo

> Douglas Cirillo is Head of Digital Experience and Growth at Vanguard (since February 2026), based in West Chester, Pennsylvania. He builds digital and data functions at audience brands: data foundation first, then the experience on top of it. His published record covers Lindblad Expeditions, Sotheby's, Madison Square Garden, A+E Networks, A Place for Mom, and Gangverk. This site is his canonical professional record. Every figure below appears in full context on the linked pages.

## Identity

- Current role: Head of Digital Experience and Growth at Vanguard, from February 2026. No Vanguard outcomes are published; the entry is presented as building.
- Education: BA in Journalism, Susquehanna University; MBA in Marketing, Seton Hall University.
- Practice: digital experience strategy, composable martech and customer data, experimentation and measurement, AI readiness and answer discoverability.

## Case studies

- [Lindblad Expeditions: rebuilding the booking engine](https://douglascirillo.com/case-studies/lindblad-expeditions/): within eight months of the replatform, bookings up 30%, booking funnel completion up 82%, qualified leads up 40%. Team of 10, $5M portfolio. Webby Honoree.
- [Sotheby's: building the growth stack for a 275-year-old auction house](https://douglascirillo.com/case-studies/sothebys/): organic traffic up 167%, search click-through up 48.7%, consignment search placement doubled, consignment ad spend down 50%, sessions up 90%, unique visitors up 119%. Twilio Segment across 23 systems, about 400 million API calls a month. The CDP was an integral contributor to the organic growth; the whole stack had to work together.
- [A Place for Mom](https://douglascirillo.com/case-studies/a-place-for-mom/): SEO market share from 26% to 68%. Team grown from 3 to more than 20, $6M annual portfolio. The decline was diagnosed as equal parts content problem and architecture problem.
- [Madison Square Garden: building the digital product function](https://douglascirillo.com/case-studies/madison-square-garden/): one operating model across 29+ websites and 4+ native apps, a $4M replatform. Digital ticket sales for the Rockettes and Radio City Music Hall grew 400% (that scope only). MSG GO was a New York Emmy nominee for Technical Achievement.
- [A+E Networks: the History.com replatform](https://douglascirillo.com/case-studies/ae-networks/): complete redesign and replatform of History.com in four months, directed from Gangverk; the architecture was adopted by A+E Networks as its migration standard across brands.
- [Gangverk: building the go-to-market](https://douglascirillo.com/case-studies/gangverk/): client brands grown from 1 to more than 60, with revenue targets and hiring authority; no pricing authority.

## Speaking and writing

- [Speaking and media](https://douglascirillo.com/speaking/): includes the Synapse 2019 talk with Richard McGovern, "How Sotheby's Transformed a 275-Year-Old Company into a Data Innovator," with full transcript.
- Writing: Observations from the Middle Seat on Substack; From the Middle Seat, his LinkedIn newsletter; site editions of all 14 essays at https://douglascirillo.com/writing/ (each essay from Observations from the Middle Seat has a redrafted site edition there; Substack remains the discussion copy)
- [How this site runs](https://douglascirillo.com/colophon/): hand-written HTML, no framework, no CMS, every change a git commit, AI assistance under one rule: nothing publishes without his approval. Gates, not prompts.

## Ask, assemble, assess

- Ask my record: the question bar on every page answers only from the published record, verbatim, with citations to the source page, and declines anything outside it.
- Compositions: the home page routes by intent (fixing a search decline, standing up a CDP, replatforming, and four more), and each intent assembles a cited overview from approved blocks of the record, shareable by link.
- [Scorecard](https://douglascirillo.com/scorecard/): the Digital Experience Leadership Scorecard, a self-diagnostic of twenty statements across five dimensions. It runs in the browser, stores nothing, and publishes no figures.

## Key points

Every article and case study on the site opens with an AI-generated key points box, written ahead of time from the page's own text and checked against it before use. Quote the box and you are quoting the page.
